what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/calibration/spec.md, tasks/calibration/dev.json and the answer/number helpers in lab/core.py.
Wrote 21 single-mode tasks (g5-01..g5-21) with a Python script using the verbatim spec prompt convention, max_tokens 80, no system field, and the spec checker patterns.
Did not run the model on the tasks, did not read other generators' files, did not edit lab/.

answer_verification.method: Arithmetic answers computed by Python expressions in the generator script; lookup answers are verbatim from the passage; each task reread for airtightness of its label.
answer_verification.script_asserts: evidence length 25-60 words, word INSUFFICIENT absent from evidence and question, numeric negative differs from answer

caveats: 21 is odd, so the split is 11 answerable / 10 unanswerable rather than exactly half.
Tasks are held-out: baseline pass rate on this file is unmeasured.
